label: local

unit.note: Each call prices a 5-item cart: 5 sequential Product reads through the JSPI import.

instantiation.note: workerd, in-Worker clock. 5 runs of 200; medians. firstMs: the first instance in the run (core modules are compiled at upload, so no compilation). meanMs: each later bare instantiation. warmCallMs: a 5-read PriceCart call (in-memory reads) on an existing instance. freshCallMs: instantiate + the same call.

memory.note: Resident set of the workerd process while N bare instances are held live (ps rss, KiB), after 300 ms to settle. perInstanceKiB = (rss at 200 - rss at 1) / 199. It includes jco's per-instance JS objects, the core instances and their linear memory, all of which the pool keeps per idle instance.

throughput.note: workerd, in-Worker clock, rounds of c concurrent calls on one isolate. io: every read waits 5 ms (scheduler.wait), ms is the median of 9 rounds. memory: reads resolve from memory with no I/O, ms is the mean of 200 rounds (single rounds are often under the clock's 1 ms resolution). The ideal for io is about 25 ms at any concurrency (5 sequential 5 ms reads). interleaved: every call made its first read before any call made its last.

failure.note: Three calls at once on one isolate, every read waiting 5 ms: a, then x whose last read fails, then b. Then three sequential calls and two concurrent ones. Each call is raced against a 2 s timer (hung). trap: the read answers a price the unit cannot parse, and it aborts (a WASM trap). throw: the handle throws (a host defect). missing: the handle's NotFound (a declared failure, returned as a result). Good calls price to 3.75.

otherRuns.note: Summaries of four earlier runs of this script on the same machine the same day (the same strategies; the first two did not measure 64 concurrent calls). Kept because the machine was shared and load varied between runs; the ranking held in every run.
